Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; arrow keys fire/aim in that direction and set facing; movement and firing combine in one action; 'wait' delays; pointer only hovers UI.

MECHANICS (observed): Enemy/projectile/green-cloud contact damages player; HUD shows hearts (hollow when lost) plus coin/key/bomb counters. Rocks, TNT barrels, locked chests, poop and braziers block movement/tears. Poop is destructible by tears (no drop confirmed). Pedestal items collected by touch. TECH X = radial ring/laser tears (~1.5-tile radius, short range, wide arc); destroys poop, kills enemies at close range; bursts render only briefly, so screenshots often miss them—use ring origin to locate self when sprite is hidden. Locked chests need keys. TNT barrels are inert to tears but chain-detonate when a bomb explodes nearby (observed: a fuse-lit sprite near the left barrel column triggered a chain that cost a heart). Placing a held bomb (count decremented) blew up fat enemies—bombs are effective room-clearers; step ~2 tiles away first. Fuse-lit hovering bomb sprite is a PICKUP, not an enemy or self-detonating bomb: touching it did nothing harmful but incremented bomb count +1 (observed).

PLAYER SPRITE (observed, important): appearance alternates and can mislead—white round face, monitor/TV face, striped egg, old bald figure, golden tint (damage-invulnerability flash). It sometimes is invisible for frames. Confirm identity by moving and seeing which sprite responds; enemies never show the screen/TV face. One 'enemy' repeatedly mistaken for hostile was actually the player.

ENEMIES: gray winged flies; fat pink enemies (gray shell clumps on head early, tanky, flash red near death then enrage skull-face, chase, fire black teardrop columns; avoid point-blank—contact repeatedly drained hearts; killed efficiently by bomb); white-faced round enemies (spawn shelled in rock ring, emerge exposed, show smoke puffs when hit, enrage dark open mouth, emit green orbs, die in a damaging green cloud; one died to ring laser, others took many hits; respawned repeatedly in a wave room with no end); blue orbs/droplets and blue spiders chase; cup-shaped and goo spawners emit orbs; fire-skull; hooded blobs; wall skull carving (hazard unconfirmed); a green blob once dissipated harmlessly.

ROOM/DOOR RULES (hypothesis): doors fail to transition until enemies cleared (observed repeatedly); transitions need near-exact centering on the door and sometimes repeated presses while centered; off-center presses fail.

NAVIGATION (observed chain): Tutorial room (wall MOVE/ATTACK/BOMB/ITEM diagrams; top door, bottom door, dark right-wall panel with red dots—inert to presses). Bottom door -> brazier room (four lit corner braziers, central rock ring now holding a locked chest, poop pile left of ring, golden gate bottom center, top alcove back to tutorial). Bottom gate -> item room with pedestal (TECH X) ; its top gold-trimmed door returns to brazier room. Tutorial top door -> rock room (scattered rocks, left gold keyhole door, top and bottom doors; shelled white-faced enemy appears here). Rock room top door -> TNT room (barrel column along left wall, two barrels center-right, two gray locked chests against left wall behind barrels, two floor hatch/crawlspace marks at bottom wall, bomb pickup floating, top and bottom doors). TNT room top door -> fat-enemy room (two fat enemies, rocks at edges, a TNT barrel, spiked gate-like structure on left wall, dark altar on right holding a gold bomb-like item with a golden key resting nearby; a gray round-headed creature appeared later). Minimap (top-right, current room highlighted) showed key icon in room above rock/TNT rooms and skull icons on rooms above fat-enemy room—icon meanings are guesses.

FAILED STRATEGIES: fighting fat enemies at point-blank/contact range repeatedly cost hearts; firing through central rocks wasted shots; waiting on the fuse-lit bomb sprite accomplished nothing; pressing the gold keyhole door without a key never opens it; the tutorial right-wall panel never opened; lingering in green bursts drains hearts fast; guessing player identity from sprite look wasted several turns—always verify by movement.

UNRESOLVED: whether doors unlock only on full clear; whether the wave room is clearable/exitable at all; whether the rock-room keyhole door opens with the golden key (keys stayed 00 while key lay uncollected on the altar—pickup unconfirmed); whether green orbs damage or can be absorbed (one lodged with no immediate heart loss); whether the right-wall panel is a functional door; meanings of minimap icons; whether the wall skull carving fires hazards; whether gilded poop is destructible/drops items; why all hearts showed hollow while the player still acted (revive/extra-life state? death timing unclear); whether the altar gold item is purchasable (coins 00) or a bomb pickup; whether green bursts from white-faced deaths linger rather than instant damage.
